description: This file defines a dependency function 'require_db_available' that ensures MongoDB is configured and accessible. It performs a lazy check for database availability and raises an HTTP 503 error if the database is not reachable. The function is used to safeguard routes that require database access in a FastAPI application.

methods.name: require_db_available()
methods.description: Dependency to ensure MongoDB is configured and available, performs a lazy check and raises an HTTP exception if not available.
